description: This file defines the NextcloudAPIProvider class which manages connections to a Nextcloud API, supporting both default and self-signed certificate configurations. It sets up Retrofit clients with customizable SSL contexts and logging interceptors based on user preferences.

classes.name: NextcloudAPIProvider
classes.description: Provider class to manage Nextcloud API connections with support for trust configurations and SSL settings.

methods.name: getAPI
methods.description: Returns a configured NextcloudAPI instance based on user preference for trusting self-signed certificates.

methods.name: builder
methods.description: Creates and configures a Retrofit.Builder instance with base URL and JSON converter.

methods.name: createDefaultClient
methods.description: Creates an OkHttpClient with logging interceptors for default (trusted CA) connection, without special SSL configuration.

methods.name: createSelfSignedTrustingClient
methods.description: Creates an OkHttpClient that accepts all SSL certificates, suitable for self-signed certificates, with logging interceptors.
